summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload smuggled outside declared files
details: The package's package.json preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime as a zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a ~728KB heavily obfuscated sibling file math_init.js at the package root. math_init.js is an obfuscator.io-style rotated string/opcode array (WV8StW / n7gIxM dispatcher, single-letter globals, hex identifiers) and is not listed in the package.json files field (files: ["lib/*"]), so it is shipped outside the author's declared publish surface. setup.mjs itself uses _0xXXXXXX identifier obfuscation. The package's advertised purpose is a Vue.js checkbox UI component in lib/, which has no need for a second language runtime at install time or for executing a large opaque JS blob. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern — fetch Bun, then run attacker-controlled code under it — evades scanners that inspect only Node-resolved code, and installing the package on a default `npm install` executes the obfuscated payload with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
